integrity: Self-contained proof of the infinite assertion; accompanying finite checks independently enumerate small read-distance conflict graphs. Source comparisons do not certify global bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: All-length theorem only for binary Hamming weight exactly two, three cyclic read symbols, distance at least six, and n at least six. Independently validated only by reproducible finite computational checks, not by an external audit.
title: Exact weight-two capacity for binary three-symbol read codes
